lyrics:
[Intro: stop-start guitar riff, snare hits, building]

[Verse 1: playful, watching, full band]
There he goes, crossing at the light
Newspaper folded, collar right
I've seen that walk before somewhere
Goodness
Well, hello there

[Verse 2: playful, a little bolder]
There he goes, slowing by the shop
Looking in the window, coming to a stop
Is he lost or is he shy?
Say something, don't just stand and sigh

[Growl: spoken aside, riff underneath]
Grrr
Oh, behave

[Bridge: softer, strings, hopeful]
If he turns left, I'll let it be
If he turns right, he's coming for tea
I've got a kettle and a second cup
I've got a lot of time to make up

[Verse 3: band drops, resigned]
There he goes, down toward the square
I should have waved, I should have dared
It's getting late, the bench is cold
Oh well, that's that, I'm far too old

[Break: riff stops, one drum, spoken]
Hang on
Is that his paper?
He's left his paper

[Final Verse: riff returns, full band, delighted]
There he is, turning at the light
Patting his pockets, what a sight
He's crossing over, coming near
Well
Hello there

[Outro: riff, final chord, a laugh]
